One relevance layer starts with a measured graph

scripts/seo/link-graph.mjs walks every .mdx page under docs/site/content, extracts every internal href and MDX link, and emits the graph plus this audit. Nothing here changes the product; it is the baseline the next two PRs spend against. No Search Console export was present at /tmp/sc31/gsc-orchestkit.csv, so the position-8-to-20 join was skipped and the README says so.
